turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Clearer if you face me and talk slowly.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I brought her in today. She has been uneasy about her chest.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tell me what brought you in today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I have not felt right lately, my chest is bothering me.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: When did this start?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: About three days ago, I think.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Can you describe the pain for me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It is a tight squeezing feeling in the middle.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does it travel to your neck or shoulder?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, it goes down my left arm a little.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does anything make it better?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Sitting quietly makes it better.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does walking or climbing stairs bring it on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, it comes even when I am sitting.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you fainted or felt like you might pass out?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not fainted.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you get sweaty or clammy when it happens?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, I get clammy.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Does heart disease run in your family?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Do you smoke, or have high blood pressure, diabetes or high cholesterol?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I do not have any of those problems.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Have you ever had a heart procedure, like a stent or bypass surgery?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I have not had any heart procedures.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: What medicines do you take every day?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I take Lisinopril and Metformin.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Before we finish, let me go over the plan. First, come back to this clinic in one week. Second, get a heart tracing and a blood test today. Third, call 911 if the pain gets worse or does not stop. Just so I know I explained it clearly, can you tell me in your own words what you will do?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I will come back here in a week, get the heart tracing and the blood test today and call 911 if the pain gets worse or will not stop.

turns.speaker: caregiver
turns.text: I will make sure she follows the plan.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Is there anything else you want to ask me?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, I think I understand.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Take care, and we will see you soon.
